beats.line: In one summer, Mia's lemonade stand became the busiest on the street.
title: One summer
beats.metaphor: sales line chart shoots up with the lemonade cup riding it

beats.line: Her secret was simple: fresh lemons, fair prices, and a friendly smile.
title: Her secret
beats.metaphor: kid shouts in a speech bubble; checklist ticks in

beats.line: Then the stand next door started giving away free cookies.
title: Free cookies
beats.metaphor: balance scale: lemonade vs cookie, tips toward the cookie

beats.line: Today, the stand is just a happy memory.
beats.metaphor: the scene freezes into a taped polaroid
